page.subtitle: Scan the cloned repo to surface house rules, each backed by a file and line you can verify, then turn the ones you accept into a skill.
page.meta: Detected from {count, plural, =1 {1 sample file} other {# sample files}} · last scan {when}
page.metaRunning: Scanning {count, plural, =0 {the repo} =1 {1 sample file} other {# sample files}}…

noRepo.title: Select a repository
noRepo.body: Conventions are extracted per repository. Pick one in the repo switcher at the top of the sidebar.

notCloned.title: Repository not cloned yet
notCloned.body: The extractor reads files from the local clone. Wait for the clone and index to finish, then run a scan.

empty.title: No conventions extracted yet
empty.body: Run a scan: the extractor picks the config files and the top-ranked source files in code, asks the conventions model for rules, and keeps only rules whose evidence line really exists.

allRejected.title: Every candidate is rejected
allRejected.body: Re-scan to look for new rules, or show the rejected ones to reconsider.

modal.title: Create skill from conventions
modal.banner: Merged from {count, plural, =1 {1 accepted convention} other {# accepted conventions}} in {repo}. Everything below is editable before you save.
modal.existing: A skill named {name} already exists; saving writes a new version of it instead of a second skill.
modal.name: Name
modal.nameHint: Kebab-case slug. The criterion name is repo-conventions; rename it to keep several sets side by side.
modal.descriptionHint: The skill's interface, written as a directive for the agent.
modal.enabledHint: Whether this block is added to agents' prompts.
modal.agentHint: The skill is attached to this agent's Skills tab at the end of its list.
modal.footerNote: Saved as a new version · added to Skills Lab
modal.loadError: Could not build the skill draft.
